Test Case: Verify all required fields are present on Sign Up page
Test Steps: Navigate to Sign Up tab → Observe all input fields and buttons
Expected Result: Full Name, Phone Number, DOB, Gender, Email, Password, Confirm Password, Captcha, Sign Up button should be visible

Test Case: Verify user can successfully sign up with valid data
Test Steps: Fill all fields with valid data → Enter Captcha → Click Sign Up
Expected Result: User account is created and confirmation message appears

Test Case: Verify error message appears when passwords do not match
Test Steps: Fill all fields → Enter mismatched Password and Confirm Password → Click Sign Up

Test Case: Verify CAPTCHA must be entered for successful signup
Test Steps: Fill all fields correctly → Do not enter CAPTCHA → Click Sign Up
Expected Result: Signup fails with error message for CAPTCHA

Test Case: Verify all required fields are present on Sign In page
Expected Result: Email and Password input fields should be visible with Sign In button
Actual Result: Sign In form is displayed correctly

Test Case: Verify user can sign in with correct credentials
Test Steps: Enter registered Email and Password → Click Sign In
Expected Result: User is logged in and redirected to dashboard

Test Case: Verify login fails with incorrect credentials
Test Steps: Enter incorrect email or password → Click Sign In

Test Case: Verify 'Forgot your password?' link is working
Expected Result: User is redirected to reset password page

Test Case: Verify email verification is required after sign up
Test Steps:
1. Complete Sign Up form
2. Submit
3. Check inbox and click confirmation link
Expected Result: Email is received with verification link; user must click to activate account

Test Case: Verify missing UI message for post-signup confirmation
Test Steps:
1. Submit valid Sign Up form
2. Observe on-screen feedback
Expected Result: UI should inform user to verify their email

Test Case: Try to log in with unverified email
Test Steps:
1. Sign up with a new email
2. Don’t click verification link
3. Try to log in
Expected Result: Login fails with message: “No active account found with the given credentials”

Test Case: Try to log in with wrong password
Test Steps:
1. Use correct email and wrong password
2. Click Sign In
Expected Result: Error message: “No active account found with the given credentials"

Test Case: Email verification with an expired or used link
Expected Result: Error or redirect with message: “Invalid or expired token”

Test Case: Sign up using letters in phone number
Test Steps: Enter abc123 in phone number field → Submit form
Expected Result: Validation error: “Phone number must contain digits only”

Test Case: Sign up with a future date of birth
